description:
Outcome: A runnable development base enables phone-based garden workflows and email, from brief.md §Constraints and owner sign-in/digest decisions.
Scope: Python/Django server-rendered responsive app, PostgreSQL migrations, email adapter, scheduled management-command interface, secrets configuration, synthetic fixtures, provider/cost/provisioning documentation, CI and test/deployment/runtime verification commands.
Excludes: Product workflows; provisioning paid accounts during setup.
Acceptance: Reproducible local startup and persistence after restart; test sources collected; sandbox email and scheduled-command execution demonstrated; hosting/email choices and owner provisioning documented. Establish actual verification commands and enable supported Full pipeline stages only after evidence exists. Keep BUILD disabled if deployment needs no build artifact.
Behaviour: Startup, migration and mail failures provide actionable recovery without logging credentials or link tokens.
Verification: Smoke startup, migration recovery rehearsal, collected sample test, sandbox mail and scheduler evidence; document deployment packaging and validate with python manage.py check (not build evidence).
Prerequisites: none.
Assumptions: Approved Python/Django/PostgreSQL stack; hosting/email providers selected here with costs documented; owner provisions accounts.
title: Establish application, email and verification tooling
